user.title: Choose the lock
user.description: Pick the lock. Tuya Bluetooth locks advertise as "TY"; if you have several, match the MAC address shown in Smart Life (device → ✎ → Device information).

credentials.title: Lock keys
credentials.description:
Enter the keys for {address}. The README explains where each one comes from.

Close Smart Life first: the lock accepts only one Bluetooth connection at a time. Setup only logs in to check the keys; it does not unlock.

data_description.local_key: 16 characters. Tuya IoT platform → API Explorer → Query Device Details → local_key.
data_description.uuid: From the same Query Device Details result (uuid field).
data_description.device_id: The lock's Device ID, shown in the Tuya IoT platform (Devices tab).
data_description.check_code: 8 characters the app sends with every unlock. See the README: "Finding the check code".

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter lock keys
reauth_confirm.description: The lock at {address} rejected the stored keys. This happens if it was removed or re-paired in Smart Life. Enter the current keys.

data_description.local_key: 16 characters. Tuya IoT platform → API Explorer → Query Device Details → local_key.
data_description.uuid: From the same Query Device Details result (uuid field).
data_description.device_id: The lock's Device ID, shown in the Tuya IoT platform (Devices tab).
data_description.check_code: 8 characters the app sends with every unlock. See the README: "Finding the check code".

method.title: Get the lock's keys
method.description: The lock at {address} needs its Tuya keys. Home Assistant can fetch them from your Tuya developer account (the cloud is only used now, not afterwards), or you can type them in.

menu_options.cloud: Log in to my Tuya developer account (automatic)

cloud.title: Tuya developer account
cloud.description:
Enter your project's keys from platform.tuya.com → Cloud → Development → your project → Overview → Authorization Key. The project must have your Smart Life account linked (Devices → Link App Account).

Home Assistant finds the lock in your account automatically, checks the keys on the lock (without unlocking), and remembers this account so adding more locks takes one click.

cloud_pick.title: Which lock is this?
cloud_pick.description: The lock at {address} isn't broadcasting its identity right now, so pick it from your account.

error.not_advertising: The lock isn't advertising. Is Smart Life connected to it, or is it out of range?
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the lock. Try again.
error.invalid_local_key: The local key looks too short.
error.invalid_check_code: The check code must be exactly 8 characters.
error.invalid_cloud_auth: Tuya rejected the Access ID or Secret.
error.cloud_error: The Tuya cloud returned an error: {error}. If it mentions your subscription or permissions, renew the free IoT Core trial in your project's Service API page.
error.no_cloud_locks: No locks were found in this Tuya project. Link your Smart Life account to the project (Devices → Link App Account) and make sure its data centre matches your account's region.

abort.already_configured: This lock is already set up.
abort.no_devices_found: No Tuya BLE devices found. Close Smart Life and make sure a Bluetooth adapter or proxy is in range.
abort.not_in_account: This lock isn't in the linked Tuya account. Is it paired to a different Smart Life account?
abort.no_cloud_locks: All the locks in your Tuya account are already set up.

data.idle_timeout: Stay connected after activity (seconds, 0 = always connected)

data_description.idle_timeout: While connected, state changes arrive instantly and commands are fast, but Smart Life cannot connect.
data_description.poll_interval: Each refresh briefly connects to the lock.
